budget.title: Half-Day Szentendre Nightlife Budget Tour
budget.summary: A short and affordable evening route — light exploring followed by relaxed budget-friendly bar hopping.

schedule.title: Old Town Afternoon Walk
schedule.description: Begin with a casual stroll through the historic center — narrow alleys, cozy courtyards, and colorful buildings.

schedule.title: Local Budget Snack
schedule.description: Warm up for the night with something simple like lángos, goulash soup, or a savory pastry.

schedule.title: Budget Bars on Dumtsa Street
schedule.description: Hop between the small, affordable bars on Dumtsa utca — friendly staff, local crowd, and cheap drinks.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Szentendre Nightlife Comfort Route
comfortable.summary: A calm half-day route with a nice dinner and a comfortable, stylish nightlife finish.

schedule.title: Riverside Afternoon Walk
schedule.description: Enjoy the soft evening light while walking along the Danube.

schedule.title: Comfortable Local Dinner
schedule.description: Have a relaxing Hungarian meal — soups, stews, or handmade dishes in a cozy restaurant.

schedule.title: Elegant Bars & Wine Spots
schedule.description: Visit one or two stylish bars serving cocktails, wine, or spritz with a good atmosphere.

budget.title: Half-Day Nightlife Veggie Budget Route
budget.summary: Vegetarian-friendly food and relaxed bars — an easy and affordable evening in Szentendre.

schedule.title: Old Town Pre-Nightwalk
schedule.description: Walk through Szentendre’s artistic streets as the town begins to quiet down.

schedule.title: Veggie-Friendly Budget Snack
schedule.description: Grab a light, inexpensive vegetarian bite — salad, soup, or pastry.

schedule.title: Casual Bars Around Dumtsa Street
schedule.description: Visit relaxed bars with low drink prices and a mix of locals and travelers.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Nightlife Veggie Comfort Plan
comfortable.summary: A comfortable evening plan with refined vegetarian dining and mellow night spots.

schedule.title: Peaceful Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Start with a gentle walk along the Danube as the sun begins to set.

schedule.title: Comfortable Vegetarian Dinner
schedule.description: A sit-down restaurant with creative vegetarian meals — pastas, bowls, or fresh salads.

schedule.title: Stylish Bars with Light Music
schedule.description: Enjoy cocktails or wine at a chic bar with ambient lighting and soft music.

budget.title: Half-Day Nightlife Tasting Budget Plan
budget.summary: Try a mix of small snacks and enjoy affordable bars — a fun mini tasting night.

schedule.title: Snack & Walk Combo
schedule.description: Pick up a couple of small bites from a bakery and wander through scenic parts of town.

schedule.title: Street Food Stop
schedule.description: Grab something quick like lángos or a small sandwich — cheap and tasty.

schedule.title: Budget Bar Hopping
schedule.description: Explore Szentendre’s cheapest bars — a perfect tasting-style night on a budget.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Nightlife Tasting Comfort Route
comfortable.summary: A tasting-style half-day evening: shared dishes, cocktail sampling, and relaxed nighttime vibes.

schedule.title: Afternoon Café & Dessert
schedule.description: Start with a coffee and a small dessert in a cozy café.

schedule.title: Shared Small Plates Dinner
schedule.description: Try two or three different dishes — a perfect warm-up for the evening.

schedule.title: Cocktail or Wine Bar Hopping
schedule.description: Visit 1–2 bars offering creative cocktails or high-quality wines with chill vibes.
